versions.changelog: Deprecate this skill and redirect users to @Cole-Z/govee-control as the canonical maintained version.

- Adds step-by-step instructions for obtaining a Govee API key through the Govee Developer portal.
- Expands security guidance: now recommends per-user secrets files under $HOME instead of /root, and avoids broad variable exports.
- Adds explicit Linux requirements and optional jq installation check.
- Updates description to include getting an API key.
- Rephrases and clarifies setup and safety instructions.

Initial release: Manual, secure Govee OpenAPI control with detailed curl setup.

- Guides users to set up API keys securely, avoiding key leaks.
- Provides step-by-step curl commands for device listing, state checking, power, brightness, and color control.
- Emphasizes using placeholders for sensitive information; no scripts included.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and security reminders for safe key handling.
